recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在大型泡沫狀巨噬細胞（胞質充滿細小透明空泡），C 圖另有胞質呈藍色顆粒狀的海藍色組織球（sea-blue histiocyte）；D 圖胸部 X 光顯示網狀間質浸潤（箭頭），組合起來符合 Niemann-Pick B 型。
features: Large foamy macrophages with abundant cytoplasm filled with fine, uniform clear vacuoles (panels A-B)
Small round to irregular nuclei, sometimes eccentric, in the storage cells
Histiocytes with bluish, finely granular cytoplasm resembling sea-blue histiocytes (panel C)
Background of normal trilineage hematopoietic precursors without increased plasma cells
Chest radiograph (panel D) showing bilateral reticular interstitial markings, arrow at right lower zone
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show normal trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered large storage histiocytes. These cells have abundant cytoplasm filled with small uniform clear vacuoles producing a foamy appearance, with small eccentric nuclei; other histiocytes contain bluish granular cytoplasm consistent with sea-blue histiocytes. No increase in atypical plasma cells is evident. The accompanying chest radiograph shows bilateral reticular interstitial infiltrates. Findings are consistent with a lipid storage disorder such as Niemann-Pick disease type B (acid sphingomyelinase deficiency), to be confirmed by enzyme assay and SMPD1 genetic testing.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete clear vacuoles and show low glucocerebrosidase activity.
NPC foam cells are morphologically similar but acid sphingomyelinase activity is normal, with NPC1/NPC2 mutations and neurologic disease.

ddx.dx: Secondary pseudo-storage histiocytes (e.g., myeloma, CML, ITP)
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher or sea-blue histiocytes arise from high cell turnover and occur alongside the underlying neoplasm, such as clonal plasma cells in myeloma.
